description:
This protocol performs the 'Post Tagmentation Cleanup' section of the Nextera DNA Flex Library Prep protocol.
Links:
 Cherrypick Samples
 Tagment DNA
 Post Tagmentation Cleanup
 Amplify Tagmented DNA
* Cleanup Libraries



Opentrons magnetic module
Bio-Rad Hard Shell 96-well low profile PCR plate 200ul #hsp9601
USA Scientific 12-channel reservoir 22ml #1061-8150
P300 Single/multi-channel electronic pipette
300ul Opentrons tipracks



Add 10ul of TSB to each sample, seal the plate with Microseal B, place on the preprogrammed thermal cycler, and run the PTC program.
12-channel reservoir (slot 3)
 channel 1: TWB
 channel 2: TWB (only needed if number of samples > 48)
* channel 12: liquid waste (loaded empty)

workflow.text: Seal the plate, and keep on the magnetic module. The TWB  remains in the wells to prevent overdrying of the beads
